operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm sources:check
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: retain exact source, a private native export and installation secrets; restore only into empty resources at the release that made the archive, verify records and original attachment bytes, then upgrade source in place. Preserve applied migration names and bytes.
